# labeled blocks are represented as arrays of nested label maps
 def blocks(text, out):
  pat=re.compile(r'(\w+)\s+"([^"]+)"\s+"([^"]+)"\s*\{')
  while True:
   m=pat.search(text)
   if not m: break
   pos=m.end(); dep=1; q=pos
   while q<len(text) and dep:
    if text[q]=='{':dep+=1
    elif text[q]=='}':dep-=1
    q+=1
   body=text[pos:q-1]; inner=parse(body)
   out.setdefault(m.group(1),[])
   a=out[m.group(1)]; first=next((z for z in a if isinstance(z,dict) and m.group(2) in z),None)
   if first is None: first={m.group(2):[]};a.append(first)
   # HCL's third header token is a nested label under the second.
   second=first[m.group(2)]
   if second and isinstance(second[-1],dict) and m.group(3) in second[-1]:
    second[-1][m.group(3)].append(inner)
   else:
    second.append({m.group(3):[inner]})
   text=text[:m.start()]+text[q:]
  # unlabeled blocks, e.g. `foo { a = 1 }`
  pat=re.compile(r'(\w+)\s*\{')
  while True:
   m=pat.search(text)
